thread:
alex_cust: Hey team — starting this morning our embeddings from the /v1/embeddings call for model=embed-large-v2 are the wrong length. Used to be 4096, now responses are 4032. Breaking our vector index. Example req id: req_0a1b2c.
mira_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the curl you used and the model param?
alex_cust: sure — here is a minimal repro:
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","input":"hello world"}'
```
Response snippet we got: `{ "id":"req_0a1b2c", "model":"embed-large-v2", "embedding_length":4032, "embedding": [ ... ] }`
mira_support: thanks — did you recently pin a variant or lock a model version? any recent customer-facing change?
alex_cust: we pinned to variant tag `embed-large-v2@2026-03-05-pin` last week for stability. No changes on our side since then.
eugene_infra: investigating. quick query against model registry shows alias `embed-large-v2@2026-03-05-pin` resolves to variant id `qv-embed-large-4bit` (quantized). That variant's metadata has `vector_dim: 4032` (looks wrong). Digging into migration logs.
kai_sre: fwiw, batching/prefix cache won't change dim — this is a model metadata/variant mapping issue.
mira_support: alex, can you DM the full response headers and the raw request id? will attach to infra logs.
alex_cust: just DM'd req_0a1b2c + headers.
deploy-bot: Note: planned action — rollback alias `embed-large-v2@2026-03-05-pin` to stable variant `st-embed-large-2026-02-15` at 3345679100 (requires no downtime).
eugene_infra: found root cause: migration script that normalized variant metadata accidentally copied a legacy compression field and recalculated dims for quantized variants, overwriting correct `vector_dim` for some variants. Patch ready to revert the bad write.
kai_sre: will run a canary metadata reload against the registry DB on prod-read replicas first.
deploy-bot: rollback executed at 3345679230 — alias `embed-large-v2@2026-03-05-pin` now points to `st-embed-large-2026-02-15`.
mira_support: alex, can you re-run the same curl now and paste the new embedding_length?
alex_cust: re-ran — Response now: `{ "id":"req_0a1b2c-2", "model":"embed-large-v2", "embedding_length":4096 }` — working again! :tada:
mira_support: great, setting ticket to monitor for 24h. we'll open a postmortem and follow up with a remediation plan.
eugene_infra: creating INC-2026-0483 for the migration script bug + adding a schema validation gate on registry writes so `vector_dim` can't be changed by that script.
kai_sre: also recommend an automated integration test that requests a small sample embedding for each public alias after any metadata change.
alex_cust: thanks everyone for the fast turnaround — appreciate it.
